name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take for a rental unit?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take for a rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel for a rental unit depends on its scope. A minor refresh, such as painting and fixture replacement, might take 1-2 weeks. A mid-range remodel involving new flooring, vanity, and shower could take 3-4 weeks. A full gut renovation, including layout changes or significant plumbing/electrical work, typically requires 4-8 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your project to minimize vacancy periods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor bathroom remodels take 1-2 weeks; mid-range 3-4 weeks; full renovations 4-8 weeks. A detailed timeline is provided after project assessment.
